ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels with a ratio of approximately 8.5:1.5 relative to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region bounded by low-intensity margins along the trailing edge. Specific dark focal point on the distal right lobe and a cluster of three small dark focal spots on the medial left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel vertex angle of approximately 118 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude is most pronounced at the distal tips, particularly the left-side tip which exhibits extreme jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, with a sharp distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single isolated high-contrast dark circular spot on the distal right lobe; sparse constellation of three dark pixel clusters in the mid-left lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, non-uniform tattering and potential tissue loss at the left distal tip compared to the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Bifurcated low-intensity (black) vertical streaks extending from the insertion point of the peduncle into the high-intensity (white) central field.
